question: For all authors from CA who are not on contract, which title of his/hers has the most year to date sales.

question: In 1994 which title had less order quanty than the average order quantity? Find the title name, type and price.

question: For how long was the complaint filed by Matthew Pierce on 2016/10/28 delayed?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT 365 * (TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date sent to company" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date received" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY')) + 30 * (TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date sent to company" AS TIMESTAMP), 'MI') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date received" AS TIMESTAMP), 'MI')) + (TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date sent to company" AS TIMESTAMP), 'DD') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date received" AS TIMESTAMP), 'DD')) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN events AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.Client_ID WHERE T1.first = 'Matthew' AND T1.last = 'Pierce' AND T2."Date received" = '2016-10-28'

question: How many days delay for the complaint call from Mr. Brantley Julian Stanley on 2012/5/18?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT 365 * (TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date sent to company" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date received" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY')) + 30 * (TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date sent to company" AS TIMESTAMP), 'MI') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date received" AS TIMESTAMP), 'MI')) + (TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date sent to company" AS TIMESTAMP), 'DD') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date received" AS TIMESTAMP), 'DD')) AS days FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN events AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.Client_ID WHERE T2."Date received" = '2012-05-18' AND T1.sex = 'Male' AND T1.first = 'Brantley' AND T1.middle = 'Julian' AND T1.last = 'Stanley'

question: Which product got the most five stars, and how many?

question: List by their ID the complaints received by the company on 25/09/2014 that took the longest.

question: In 2015, how many complaints about Billing disputes were sent by clients in Portland?

question: How many production companies made more than 150 movies?

question: Calculate the average income made by movies using the keyword "paris". List the title of the movies.

question: Please list the IDs of all the trains that run in the east direction and have less than 4 cars.

question: Please list the directions in which the trains with at least one empty-loaded car run.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.direction FROM cars AS T1 INNER JOIN trains AS T2 ON T1.train_id = T2.id WHERE T1.load_num = 0

question: In which direction does the train with an ellipse-shape car run?

question: Please list the shapes of all the head cars on the trains that run in the east direction.

question: Among the cars on a train that runs in the east direction, how many of them have a flat roof and a circle load shape?

question: Please list the directions in which the trains with 4 short cars run.

question: What is the average number of cars on trains that run in the east direction?

question: Among the trains running east, how many trains have at least 4 cars?

question: Which direction do most of the trains with rectangle-shaped second cars run?

question: Among the trains running west, how many trains have no more than one car with an open roof?

question: How many cars running east have double-sided tail cars?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM trains AS T1 INNER JOIN cars AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.train_id INNER JOIN (SELECT train_id, MAX(position) AS trailPosi FROM cars GROUP BY train_id) AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.train_id WHERE T1.direction = 'east' AND T2.position = T3.trailPosi AND T2.sides = 'double'

question: List all the directions of the trains that have empty cars.

question: Among the trains running west, how many trains have three-wheeled, jagged roof cars?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.direction = 'west' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count FROM cars AS T1 INNER JOIN trains AS T2 ON T1.train_id = T2.id WHERE T1.wheels = 3 AND T1.roof = 'jagged'

question: Provide the directions for all the trains that have 2 or less cars.

question: What is the percentage of all the trains with at least 4 cars? List the directions of the said trains.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.trailPosi >= 4 THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM trains AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT train_id, MAX(position) AS trailPosi FROM cars GROUP BY train_id) AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.train_id UNION ALL SELECT T1.direction FROM trains AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT train_id, MAX(position) AS trailPosi FROM cars AS t GROUP BY train_id) AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.train_id AND T2.trailPosi >= 4

question: For how long did Elly Koss's cystitis last?

question: Among observations in 2011, provide the names and ages of patients whose Systolic Blood Pressures are 200mmHg.

question: What is the title of episode that won the Best International TV Series Award in 2017?

question: How old was composer of the show when he was nominated for Emmy's Outstanding Music Composition for a Series in 2009. Indicate his full name as well.

question: Which episode of The simpson 20s: Season 20 has received the most nominations? Indicate the title.

question: Please indicate which writer has an episode star score greater than 5 in 2009.

question: Which title is the winner of Best International TV Series in 2017?

question: What is the average result of the question "What is your age?" in 2014's survey?

question: How many respondents younger than 25 years old did participate in the survey in 2016?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.UserID) FROM Answer AS T1 INNER JOIN Question AS T2 ON T1.QuestionID = T2.questionid WHERE T1.QuestionID = 1 AND T1.SurveyID = 2016 AND T1.AnswerText <= 25

question: How many respondents who participated in the survey in 2019 have ever sought treatment for a mental health disorder from a mental health professional?

question: Current legislator Roger F. Wicker has not been a representative for how many terms?

question: Among all the female current legislators, how many of them have served for more than 4 terms?

question: List all of the ids of the representatives belonging to the Democrat party in district 13 that ended their term on 1/3/2019?

question: Among all the current legislators who have served for more than 4 terms, what is the percentage of them being female?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender_bio = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T3.bioguide), 0) FROM (SELECT T2.bioguide, T1.gender_bio FROM current AS T1 INNER JOIN "current-terms" AS T2 ON T1.bioguide_id = T2.bioguide GROUP BY T2.bioguide HAVING COUNT(T2.bioguide) > 4) AS T3

question: Who has participated in the most Olympic Games in the database?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.full_name FROM person AS T1 INNER JOIN games_competitor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.person_id GROUP BY T2.person_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.person_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: In the Winter and Summer Olympics of 1988, which game has the most number of competitors? Find the difference of the number of competitors between the two games.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT P1, (SELECT MAX(P2) - MIN(P2) FROM (SELECT COUNT(T2.person_id) AS P2 FROM games AS T1 INNER JOIN games_competitor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.games_id WHERE T1.games_name IN ('1988 Winter', '1988 Summer') GROUP BY T1.season) ORDER BY P2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) FROM (SELECT T1.season AS P1, COUNT(T2.person_id) AS P2 FROM games AS T1 INNER JOIN games_competitor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.games_id WHERE T1.games_name IN ('1988 Winter', '1988 Summer') GROUP BY T1.season) ORDER BY P2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Which summer Olympic have the highest and lowest number of participants?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT T1.games_name FROM games AS T1 INNER JOIN games_competitor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.games_id WHERE T1.season = 'Summer' GROUP BY T1.games_year ORDER BY COUNT(T2.person_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS HIGHEST, (SELECT T1.games_name FROM games AS T1 INNER JOIN games_competitor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.games_id WHERE T1.season = 'Summer' GROUP BY T1.games_year ORDER BY COUNT(T2.person_id) NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS LOWEST

question: In which county is the residential area with the highest average income per household located?

question: Calculate the difference in the average number of vehicular hijackings and aggravated vehicular hijackings in the districts.

question: Compute the average time in minute for each age group
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.age > 13 AND T1.age <= 19 THEN 60 * TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'HH24') + TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'MI') + TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'SS') / NULLIF(60, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.age > 13 AND T1.age <= 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS teenagerAverageMins, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.age > 19 AND T1.age <= 65 THEN 60 * TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'HH24') + TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'MI') + TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'SS') / NULLIF(60, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.age > 19 AND T1.age <= 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS adultAverageMins, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.age > 65 THEN 60 * TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'HH24') + TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'MI') + TO_CHAR(CAST(ser_time AS TIMESTAMP), 'SS') / NULLIF(60, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS elderAverageMins FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN callcenterlogs AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2."rand client"

question: What is the lowest sentiment polarity score of the Basketball Stars app for people who dislikes the app pretty much and how many downloads does it have?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT MIN(T2.Sentiment_Polarity), T1.Installs FROM playstore AS T1 INNER JOIN user_reviews AS T2 ON T1.App = T2.App WHERE T1.App = 'Basketball Stars'

question: Which apps have not been updated since year 2015 and what kind of sentiment users hold on it?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT App, Sentiment FROM user_reviews WHERE App IN (SELECT App FROM playstore WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING('Last Updated' FROM LENGTH('Last Updated') - 3 FOR 4) AS INT) < 2015)

question: How much is the size of Browser 4G and how many users have a pretty positive favorability on it?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.Size, COUNT(T1.App) FROM playstore AS T1 INNER JOIN user_reviews AS T2 ON T1.App = T2.App WHERE T1.App = 'Browser 4G' AND T2.Sentiment_Polarity >= 0.5

question: List down the product IDs and names that include the word "Outdoor".
pg_gold_sql: SELECT ProductID, T FROM (SELECT ProductID, CASE WHEN "Product Name" LIKE '%Outdoor%' THEN "Product Name" ELSE NULL END AS T FROM Products) WHERE NOT T IS NULL ORDER BY T DESC NULLS LAST

question: Describe the customer names and product names which had over 3800 USD in net profit.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT "Customer Names", "Product Name" FROM (SELECT T1."Customer Names", T3."Product Name", REPLACE(T2."Unit Price", ',', '') - REPLACE(T2."Unit Cost", ',', '') AS T FROM Customers AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Orders" AS T2 ON T2._CustomerID = T1.CustomerID INNER JOIN Products AS T3 ON T3.ProductID = T2._ProductID) WHERE T > 3800

question: List out the name of orders which have delivery date of 6/13/2018.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN DeliveryDate = '6/13/18' THEN OrderNumber ELSE NULL END AS T FROM "Sales Orders") WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: State the full name of state code "GA".
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN StateCode = 'GA' THEN State ELSE NULL END AS T FROM Regions) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: How many states located in the Midwest region?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN Region = 'Midwest' THEN StateCode ELSE NULL END AS T FROM Regions) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Calculate the average net profit of phones which have sales channel of distributor.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(REPLACE(T1."Unit Price", ',', '') - REPLACE(T1."Unit Cost", ',', '')) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.OrderNumber), 0) FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN Products AS T2 ON T2.ProductID = T1._ProductID WHERE T2."Product Name" = 'Phones' AND T1."Sales Channel" = 'Distributor'

question: Calculate the average net profit of bar tools which has ordered quantity exceed 5.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(REPLACE(T1."Unit Price", ',', '') - REPLACE(T1."Unit Cost", ',', '')) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.OrderNumber), 0) FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN Products AS T2 ON T2.ProductID = T1._ProductID WHERE T2."Product Name" = 'Bar Tools' AND T1."Order Quantity" > 5

question: List out the discount levels applied for all orders from Ole Group.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1."Customer Names" = 'Ole Group' THEN T2."Discount Applied" END AS T FROM Customers AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Orders" AS T2 ON T2._CustomerID = T1.CustomerID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Please list all sale team names which had orders on 5/31/2018.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.OrderDate = '5/31/18' THEN T2."Sales Team" ELSE NULL END AS T FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Team" AS T2 ON T2.SalesTeamID = T1._SalesTeamID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: What is the unit cost of order SO - 000103?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN OrderNumber = 'SO - 000103' THEN "Unit Cost" ELSE NULL END AS T FROM "Sales Orders") WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Which product was ordered the most in 2018?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2."Product Name" FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN Products AS T2 ON T2.ProductID = T1._ProductID WHERE T1.OrderDate LIKE '%/%/18' GROUP BY T1._ProductID ORDER BY COUNT(T1._ProductID) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: List all orders where its products were shipped from Daly City.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2."City Name" = 'Daly City' THEN T1.OrderNumber END AS T FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Store Locations" AS T2 ON T2.StoreID = T1._StoreID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Name the products via wholesale channel of the store under Pacific/Honolulu time zone.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T3."Time Zone" = 'Pacific/Honolulu' AND T2."Sales Channel" = 'Wholesale' THEN T1."Product Name" ELSE NULL END AS T FROM Products AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Orders" AS T2 ON T2._ProductID = T1.ProductID INNER JOIN "Store Locations" AS T3 ON T3.StoreID = T2._StoreID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: List by ID all sales teams that have sold products at a 10% discount in store.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "Discount Applied" = '0.1' AND "Sales Channel" = 'In-Store' THEN _SalesTeamID ELSE NULL END AS T FROM "Sales Orders") WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Indicate order numbers with an order date after 1/1/2018.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN OrderDate > '1/1/18' THEN OrderNumber ELSE NULL END AS T FROM "Sales Orders") WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Name of customers who have ordered Cocktail Glasses by online sales channel.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T3."Product Name" = 'Cocktail Glasses' AND T2."Sales Channel" = 'Online' THEN T1."Customer Names" END AS T FROM Customers AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Orders" AS T2 ON T2._CustomerID = T1.CustomerID INNER JOIN Products AS T3 ON T3.ProductID = T2._ProductID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: What is the store id of the store located in the most populous county?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(Population) THEN StoreID END FROM "Store Locations"

question: Among the products with an order quantity of no less than 5 that was shipped in the month of May 2019, what is the name of the product with the lowest net profit?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2."Product Name" FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN Products AS T2 ON T2.ProductID = T1._ProductID WHERE T1."Order Quantity" > 5 AND ShipDate LIKE '5/%/19' ORDER BY REPLACE(T1."Unit Price", ',', '') - REPLACE(T1."Unit Cost", ',', '') ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

question: Identify the top customer of the store located in Gilbert, Arizona based on net profit associated with the customer relationship in 2019.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1."Customer Names" FROM Customers AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Orders" AS T2 ON T2._CustomerID = T1.CustomerID INNER JOIN "Store Locations" AS T3 ON T3.StoreID = T2._StoreID WHERE T3."City Name" = 'Gilbert' AND T2.ProcuredDate LIKE '%/%/19' ORDER BY REPLACE(T2."Unit Price", ',', '') - REPLACE(T2."Unit Cost", ',', '') DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: How many teams that played in the 2012 season belong to any of the English divisions and what percentage play in each of the divisions?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(T1.Div) AS total FROM matchs AS T1 INNER JOIN divisions AS T2 ON T2.division = T1.Div WHERE T2.country = 'England' AND T1.season = 2012) AS num, CASE WHEN 1 THEN T.result END AS percentage FROM (SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.Div) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(T1.Div) FROM matchs AS T1 INNER JOIN divisions AS T2 ON T2.division = T1.Div WHERE T2.country = 'England' AND T1.season = 2012), 0) AS result FROM matchs AS T1 INNER JOIN divisions AS T2 ON T2.division = T1.Div WHERE T2.country = 'England' AND T1.season = 2012 GROUP BY T2.division) AS T

question: Calculate the average production rate per year from 1971 to 1980. Among them, name the cars with a weight of fewer than 1800 lbs.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.ID) AS REAL) / NULLIF(9, 0) FROM production AS T1 INNER JOIN data AS T2 ON T2.ID = T1.ID WHERE T1.model_year BETWEEN 1971 AND 1980 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT T2.car_name FROM production AS T1 INNER JOIN data AS T2 ON T2.ID = T1.ID WHERE T1.model_year BETWEEN 1971 AND 1980 AND T2.weight < 1800

question: Which publisher has published the most games?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T.publisher_name FROM (SELECT T2.publisher_name, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.id) FROM game_publisher AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id GROUP BY T1.publisher_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS t

question: In which year was Panzer Tactics released on DS?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T4.release_year FROM game_publisher AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN game AS T3 ON T1.game_id = T3.id INNER JOIN game_platform AS T4 ON T1.id = T4.game_publisher_id INNER JOIN platform AS T5 ON T4.platform_id = T5.id WHERE T3.game_name = 'Panzer Tactics' AND T5.platform_name = 'DS'

question: Among the games published by Nintendo, what is the percentage of those in the genre of sports?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T4.genre_name = 'Sports' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM game AS T1 INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.game_id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T2.publisher_id = T3.id INNER JOIN genre AS T4 ON T1.genre_id = T4.id WHERE T3.publisher_name = 'Nintendo'

question: Name of the publisher of the game id 10031.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM game_publisher AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.game_id = 10031

question: How many times more is the number of games which were published by Atari than Athena?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.publisher_name = 'Atari' THEN T2.game_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.publisher_name = 'Athena' THEN T2.game_id ELSE NULL END), 0) FROM publisher AS T1 INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.publisher_id

question: How many games were released on PS4 in 2014?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.game_id) FROM platform AS T1 INNER JOIN game_platform AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.platform_id INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T3 ON T2.game_publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T1.platform_name = 'PS4' AND T2.release_year = 2014

question: What is the genre ID of the '2Xtreme' game?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T.genre_id FROM game AS T WHERE T.game_name = '2Xtreme'

question: Provide the games that can be played on the SCD platform.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T4.game_name FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN platform AS T2 ON T1.platform_id = T2.id INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T3 ON T1.game_publisher_id = T3.id INNER JOIN game AS T4 ON T3.game_id = T4.id WHERE T2.platform_name = 'SCD'

question: How many games can be played on the Wii platform?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN platform AS T2 ON T1.platform_id = T2.id WHERE T2.platform_name = 'Wii'

question: How many games were released in 2001?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.id) FROM game_platform AS T WHERE T.release_year = 2001

question: What is the average number of games published by a publisher?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T.game_id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T.publisher_id), 0) FROM game_publisher AS T

question: What is the first year a game is released?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT MIN(T.release_year) FROM game_platform AS t

question: How many games do not have any sales in Europe?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM region_sales AS T1 INNER JOIN region AS T2 ON T1.region_id = T2.id WHERE T2.region_name = 'Europe' AND T1.num_sales = 0

question: What are the years that "WiiU" got a new game?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.release_year FROM platform AS T1 INNER JOIN game_platform AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.platform_id WHERE T1.platform_name = 'WiiU' ORDER BY T2.release_year DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the ratio of game sales between North America and Japan?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.region_name = 'North America' THEN T1.num_sales ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.region_name = 'Japan' THEN T1.num_sales ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM region_sales AS T1 INNER JOIN region AS T2 ON T1.region_id = T2.id

question: Which year has the most number of video game releases?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.release_year FROM (SELECT T.release_year, COUNT(id) FROM game_platform AS T GROUP BY T.release_year ORDER BY COUNT(T.id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS T1

question: What publishers have the word 'Entertainment' in their name?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T.publisher_name FROM publisher AS T WHERE T.publisher_name LIKE '%Entertainment%'

question: Which game has sold the fewest units?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T.game_name FROM (SELECT T1.game_name FROM game AS T1 INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.game_id INNER JOIN game_platform AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.game_publisher_id INNER JOIN region_sales AS T4 ON T3.id = T4.game_platform_id ORDER BY T4.num_sales NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS t

question: What platform is the game 3Xtreme available on?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.platform_name FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN platform AS T2 ON T1.platform_id = T2.id INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T3 ON T1.game_publisher_id = T3.id INNER JOIN game AS T4 ON T3.game_id = T4.id WHERE T4.game_name = '3Xtreme'

question: Calculate the difference between sales of games from region ID 2 and region ID 3.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T.region_id = 2 THEN T.num_sales ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T.region_id = 3 THEN T.num_sales ELSE 0 END) FROM region_sales AS t

question: What are the sales made by the games in Japan region?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.region_name = 'Japan' THEN T1.num_sales ELSE 0 END) AS nums FROM region_sales AS T1 INNER JOIN region AS T2 ON T1.region_id = T2.id

question: How many game publisher IDs have published games on the X360 platform?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.game_publisher_id) FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN platform AS T2 ON T1.platform_id = T2.id WHERE T2.platform_name = 'X360'

question: Find out the difference between the number of publishers who released the games on the PS3 and X360.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.platform_name = 'PS3' THEN T1.game_publisher_id ELSE NULL END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.platform_name = 'X360' THEN T1.game_publisher_id ELSE NULL END) FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN platform AS T2 ON T1.platform_id = T2.id

question: What is the genre of the game "Grand Theft Auto V"?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.genre_name FROM game AS T1 INNER JOIN genre AS T2 ON T1.genre_id = T2.id WHERE T1.game_name = 'Grand Theft Auto V'

question: Calculate the number of games in the fighting genre.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM game AS T1 INNER JOIN genre AS T2 ON T1.genre_id = T2.id WHERE T2.genre_name = 'Fighting'

question: Calculate the total sales made by the games released in 2000.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.num_sales) FROM region_sales AS T1 INNER JOIN game_platform AS T2 ON T1.game_platform_id = T2.id WHERE T2.release_year = 2000

question: Calculate the difference in sales between the games released in 1990 and 2000.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.release_year = 2000 THEN T1.num_sales ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.release_year = 1990 THEN T1.num_sales ELSE 0 END) FROM region_sales AS T1 INNER JOIN game_platform AS T2 ON T1.game_platform_id = T2.id

question: Which cohort had the higher percentage of students who graduated from Central Alabama Community College in 2011 within 150 percent of normal/expected time, female White students or male White students?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'F' THEN T2.grad_150 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'M' THEN T2.grad_150 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'female White students' ELSE 'male White students' END FROM institution_details AS T1 INNER JOIN institution_grads AS T2 ON T2.unitid = T1.unitid WHERE T1.chronname = 'Central Alabama Community College' AND T2.year = 2011 AND T2.race = 'W'

question: Please list the names of the institutes with the percentage of male White students graduating in 2011 within 150 percent of normal/expected time over 20.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.grad_150 > 20 THEN T1.chronname ELSE NULL END AS T FROM institution_details AS T1 INNER JOIN institution_grads AS T2 ON T2.unitid = T1.unitid WHERE T2.year = 2011 AND T2.gender = 'M' AND T2.race = 'W') WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: What is the average percentage of students graduating within 100 percent of normal/expected time for Central Alabama Community College?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.grad_100_rate) FROM institution_details AS T1 INNER JOIN institution_grads AS T2 ON T2.unitid = T1.unitid WHERE T1.chronname = 'Central Alabama Community College'

question: Which state is "Mercer University" located in?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN chronname = 'Mercer University' THEN state ELSE NULL END AS T FROM institution_details) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Give the post name of "Idaho" state.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN state = 'Idaho' THEN state_post ELSE NULL END AS T FROM state_sector_details) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: What is the ratio of having the best to worse elite user in 2013?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.user_average_stars = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T2.user_id), 0), SUM(CASE WHEN T1.user_average_stars = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(T2.user_id), 0) FROM Users AS T1 INNER JOIN Elite AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T2.year_id = 2013

question: How many business have been reviewed by user ID 3 and how long have this user been with Yelp?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.business_id), TO_CHAR(CAST('now' AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - T2.user_yelping_since_year FROM Reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN Users AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_id = 3

question: What is the yearly average review done by user ID 3?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(review_stars) / NULLIF((TO_CHAR(CAST('now' AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - T1.user_yelping_since_year), 0) FROM Users AS T1 INNER JOIN Reviews AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_id = 3

question: List at least 10 users ID that has 4 as an average ratings of all reviews sent.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(user_id) FROM Users WHERE user_average_stars = 4 LIMIT 10

question: Describe category name which had above 10% in comparing with all business and categories.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.category_name FROM Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id GROUP BY T2.category_id HAVING COUNT(T2.business_id) > (SELECT COUNT(T3.business_id) FROM Business_Categories AS T3) * 0.1

question: Among the episodes aired on April of 2009, how many episodes won an award?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.episode_id) FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE SUBSTRING(T1.year FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2009' AND T2.air_date LIKE '2009-04%'

question: List the award name and persons who won the award in 2009.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT award, person FROM Award WHERE result = 'Winner' AND SUBSTRING(year FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2009'

question: How many nominations have Billy Kimball received in 2010 for The simpson 20s: Season 20?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(award_id) FROM Award WHERE person = 'Billy Kimball' AND SUBSTRING(year FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2010' AND result = 'Nominee'

question: In 2010, which episode did Joel H. Cohen win an award for?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.title FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE SUBSTRING(T1.year FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2010' AND T1.person = 'Joel H. Cohen'

question: List out the number of students who have the longest duration of absense from school and enlisted in the peace corps.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.NAME) FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.organ = 'peace_corps' ORDER BY T1.month DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Please list all the answers to the question "Any additional notes or comments" that are not null in 2014's survey.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.AnswerText FROM Question AS T1 INNER JOIN Answer AS T2 ON T1.questionid = T2.QuestionID WHERE T1.questiontext = 'Any additional notes or comments' AND T2.SurveyID = 2014 AND T2.AnswerText <> -1

question: Among the current legislators who have served for more than 6 terms, how many of them were born after 1960?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(CID) FROM (SELECT T1.bioguide_id AS CID FROM current AS T1 INNER JOIN "current-terms" AS T2 ON T1.bioguide_id = T2.bioguide WHERE T1.birthday_bio >= '1960-01-01' GROUP BY T2.bioguide HAVING COUNT(T2.bioguide) > 6)

question: State number of legislators who are not the senator among female legislators.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM current AS T1 INNER JOIN "current-terms" AS T2 ON T1.bioguide_id = T2.bioguide WHERE T1.gender_bio = 'F' AND (T2.class IS NULL OR T2.class = '')

question: In California, how many representatives ended their term in 1995?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "current-terms" WHERE state = 'CA' AND type = 'rep' AND end LIKE '1995%'

question: Who is the Lutheran representative that served in the state of Ohio for 14 years before becoming a senator?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.end AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') AS INT) - CAST(TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.start AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') AS INT)) = 14 THEN official_full_name END FROM current AS T1 INNER JOIN "current-terms" AS T2 ON T1.bioguide_id = T2.bioguide WHERE T1.religion_bio = 'Lutheran' AND T2.state = 'OH' AND T2.type = 'rep'

question: What is the name of the state with the most counties?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM state AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.abbreviation = T2.state GROUP BY T2.state ORDER BY COUNT(T2.county) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of root beers of the brand A&W sold in a day in August, 2014?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.BrandID) AS REAL) / NULLIF(31, 0) FROM rootbeer AS T1 INNER JOIN "transaction" AS T2 ON T1.RootBeerID = T2.RootBeerID INNER JOIN rootbeerbrand AS T3 ON T1.BrandID = T3.BrandID WHERE T2.TransactionDate LIKE '2014-08%' AND T3.BrandName = 'A&W'

question: Among all the root beers sold in 2014, what is the percentage of the root beers produced by the brewery AJ Stephans Beverages?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.BreweryName = 'AJ Stephans Beverages' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.BrandID), 0) FROM rootbeer AS T1 INNER JOIN "transaction" AS T2 ON T1.RootBeerID = T2.RootBeerID INNER JOIN rootbeerbrand AS T3 ON T1.BrandID = T3.BrandID WHERE T2.TransactionDate LIKE '2014%'

question: How many transactions were paid through MasterCard in 2014?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(TransactionID) FROM "transaction" WHERE CreditCardType = 'MasterCard' AND TransactionDate LIKE '2014%'

question: How many canned A&W were purchased in 2016?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.BrandID) FROM rootbeer AS T1 INNER JOIN rootbeerbrand AS T2 ON T1.BrandID = T2.BrandID WHERE T1.ContainerType = 'Can' AND T2.BrandName = 'A&W' AND T1.PurchaseDate LIKE '2016%'

question: What is the best seller root beer brand and what is the average star rating for this root beer?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.BrandID, AVG(T1.StarRating) FROM rootbeerreview AS T1 INNER JOIN "transaction" AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID INNER JOIN rootbeerbrand AS T3 ON T1.BrandID = T3.BrandID GROUP BY T3.BrandID ORDER BY COUNT(T1.BrandID) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: How many employees sold over 20,000 quantities of "Touring-2000 Blue, 50"?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SUM(Quantity) FROM Sales WHERE ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM Products WHERE Name = 'Touring-2000 Blue, 50') GROUP BY Quantity, SalesPersonID HAVING SUM(Quantity) > 20000)

question: What is the language of the book with ISBN 23755004321?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.language_name FROM book AS T1 INNER JOIN book_language AS T2 ON T1.language_id = T2.language_id WHERE T1.isbn13 = 23755004321

question: How many books were ordered in the last month of the year 2020?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_order WHERE order_date LIKE '2020-12%'

question: On what date did the customers who live at number 460 of their respective streets place their orders?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.order_date FROM cust_order AS T1 INNER JOIN address AS T2 ON T1.dest_address_id = T2.address_id WHERE T2.street_number = 460

question: For all the products, list the product name and its corresponding start date for the current standard cost.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name, T2.StartDate FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN ProductCostHistory AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.EndDate IS NULL

question: List all product names that are high in quality. Please also state its selling price.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT Name, ListPrice FROM Product WHERE Class = 'H'

question: Calculate the profit of each products. List all products with more than $100 in profit.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM Product WHERE ListPrice - StandardCost > 100

question: Which currency pair's average exchange rate for the day is the highest?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT FromCurrencyCode, ToCurrencyCode FROM CurrencyRate ORDER BY AverageRate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Who is the company's highest-paid single female employee? Include her full name and job title.

question: What is the local name of the country where "The Valley" city belongs?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.LocalName FROM City AS T1 INNER JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T1.Name = 'The Valley'

question: List down the cities belongs to the country that has surface area greater than 7000000.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name, T1.Name FROM City AS T1 INNER JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T2.SurfaceArea > 7000000

question: What is the life expectancy of the countries that uses Japanese as their language?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.LifeExpectancy) FROM CountryLanguage AS T1 INNER JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T1.Language = 'Japanese'

question: How many cities are there in the country with the surface area of 652090?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(T1.Name) FROM City AS T1 INNER JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T2.SurfaceArea = 652090 GROUP BY T2.Name

question: List down the languages of countries with an independence year between 1980 to 1995.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name, T1.Language FROM CountryLanguage AS T1 INNER JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T2.IndepYear BETWEEN 1980 AND 1995

question: How many criteria belong to ranking system ID 3?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM ranking_criteria WHERE ranking_system_id = 3

question: In 2016, what is the name of the university in Australia with the highest score in Citations criteria?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T3.university_name FROM ranking_criteria AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.ranking_criteria_id INNER JOIN university AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.university_id INNER JOIN country AS T4 ON T4.id = T3.country_id WHERE T1.criteria_name = 'Citations' AND T2.year = 2016 AND T1.id = 4 AND T4.country_name = 'Australia' ORDER BY T2.score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What are the names of the top 5 universities with the highest number of international students?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.university_name FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id ORDER BY (CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / NULLIF(100, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

question: What is the university ID of the university with the largest student staff ratio?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT university_id FROM university_year ORDER BY student_staff_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Compute the average percentage of female students.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(pct_female_students) FROM university_year

question: Provide the number of international students and number of students in 2013 in university ID 20.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT pct_international_students * num_students, num_students FROM university_year WHERE year = 2013 AND university_id = 20

question: What is the university ID of Harvard University?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT id FROM university WHERE university_name = 'Harvard University'

question: List the university ID of the university that scored 100 in 2011.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT university_id FROM university_ranking_year WHERE score = 100 AND year = 2011

question: Give the location of the university ID 112.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.id = 112

question: List the name of universities located in Spain.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.university_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T2.country_name = 'Spain'

question: Provide the country name of universities with the number of students greater than 98% of the average student population of all universities in 2013.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.country_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN university_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.university_id INNER JOIN country AS T3 ON T3.id = T1.country_id WHERE T2.year = 2013 AND T2.num_students * 100 > (SELECT AVG(num_students) FROM university_year) * 98

question: Among all universities, how many female students were there in 2011?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(num_students * pct_female_students AS REAL) / NULLIF(100, 0)) FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011

question: How many institutions with over 50,000 students in 2011 had a percentage of oversea students of more than 10%?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011 AND num_students > 50000 AND pct_international_students > 10

question: Provide the ID of the university with the highest percentage of female students in 2012.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT university_id FROM university_year WHERE year = 2012 ORDER BY pct_female_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What are the top three universities with the most international students?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.university_name FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.university_name ORDER BY SUM(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students / NULLIF(100, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

question: How many universities had over 30000 students in 2011?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011 AND num_students > 30000

question: List the universities in Denmark.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.university_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T2.country_name = 'Denmark'

question: Which country has the University of SÃ£o Paulo?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.university_name = 'University of São Paulo'

question: What is the ID of the university with the most students in 2011?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT university_id FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011 ORDER BY num_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Among the universities with over 20000 students in 2011, how many of them have an international students percentage of over 25% in the same year?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011 AND pct_international_students > 25 AND num_students > 20000

question: How many students did Harvard University have in 2011?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.num_students FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Harvard University' AND T1.year = 2011

question: Which country is Harvard University in?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.university_name = 'Harvard University'

question: Among the universities with a score in teaching of over 90 in 2011, how many of them are in the United States of America?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranking_criteria AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.ranking_criteria_id INNER JOIN university AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.university_id WHERE T1.criteria_name = 'Teaching' AND T2.year = 2011 AND T2.score > 90

question: Which country is McMaster University located in?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.university_name = 'McMaster University'

question: How many Turkish universities are there in the database?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T2.country_name = 'Turkey'

question: What is the score of university ID 68 in 2015?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT score FROM university_ranking_year WHERE year = 2015 AND university_id = 68

question: In years 2011 to 2013, what is the total number of female students in university ID 40?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(num_students * pct_female_students AS REAL) / NULLIF(100, 0)) FROM university_year WHERE year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2013 AND university_id = 40

question: Provide the score of the most populated university in 2011.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.score FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.university_id WHERE T1.year = 2011 ORDER BY T1.num_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the total number of ranking criteria under the ranking system called Shanghai Ranking?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranking_system AS T1 INNER JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.ranking_system_id WHERE T1.system_name = 'Shanghai Ranking'

question: How many universities are located in Japan?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T2.country_name = 'Japan'

question: Calculate the difference between the total number of students and the number of international international students in Univeristy of Tokyo from 2011 to 2014.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.num_students) - SUM(CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / NULLIF(100, 0)) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2014 AND T2.university_name = 'University of Tokyo'

question: Between 1/1/2012 to 12/31/2014, which date recorded the hottest temperature in weather station 1?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT "date" FROM weather WHERE station_nbr = 1 AND CAST(SUBSTRING("date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INT) BETWEEN 2012 AND 2014 ORDER BY tmax DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: How many days did the sun rise before 5 AM?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "date") AS days FROM weather WHERE sunrise < TIME('05:00:00')

question: For the third largest country, which ethinic group has the most population?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN ethnicGroup AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.Country WHERE T1.Name = (SELECT Name FROM country ORDER BY Area DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2) GROUP BY T2.Name ORDER BY T2.Percentage * T1.Population DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the fax number for the district with the most number of crimes in January, 2018?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.fax FROM District AS T1 INNER JOIN Crime AS T2 ON T1.district_no = T2.district_no WHERE T2.date LIKE '%1/2018%' GROUP BY T2.district_no ORDER BY COUNT(case_number) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the difference between the number of communities that are located on the north and south sides with a population of more than 30,000?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'South ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'North' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DIFF FROM Community_Area WHERE population > 300000

question: List down the eateries' IDs with structural inspection type in February 2016.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT business_id FROM inspections WHERE type = 'Structural Inspection' AND "date" LIKE '2016-02%'

question: In businesses with a score lower than 95 and located around the postal code of 94110, what is the percentage of businesses with a risk category of low risk?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.risk_category = 'Low Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.risk_category), 0) FROM violations AS T1 INNER JOIN inspections AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN businesses AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T2.score < 95 AND T3.postal_code = 94110

question: How many bike stations were installed in San Jose in 2014? Indicate the names of the stations.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'San Jose' AND SUBSTRING(installation_date FROM LENGTH(installation_date) - 3) = '2014' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM station UNION SELECT name FROM station WHERE city = 'San Jose' AND SUBSTRING(installation_date FROM LENGTH(installation_date) - 3) = '2014'

question: When was the hottest temperature recorded? If there are multiple dates with the hottest temperature, indicate all of the dates.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT max_temperature_f, date FROM weather WHERE max_temperature_f = (SELECT MAX(max_temperature_f) FROM weather WHERE NOT max_temperature_f IS NULL AND NOT max_temperature_f IS '')

question: What were the max gust speed and cloud clover when the customer using bike no. 10 recorded the 386 seconds duration of the trip from MLK Library to San Salvador at 1st?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.max_gust_speed_mph, T2.cloud_cover FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code AND T2.date = SUBSTRING(CAST(T1.start_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(' ' IN T1.start_date) - 1) WHERE T1.bike_id = 10 AND T2.mean_temperature_f > 62 AND T1.subscription_type = 'Customer' AND T1.start_station_name = 'MLK Library' AND T1.end_station_name = 'San Salvador at 1st' AND T1.duration = 386

question: What is the difference between the hottest temperature and the coldest temperature in in Fahrenheit on 8/29/2013 for the area where the zip code is 94107?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN zip_code = 94107 AND date = '8/29/2013' THEN max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f ELSE 0 END) FROM weather

question: Among the films that are released in 2006, how many of them are rated Adults Only in the Motion Picture Association Film Rating?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(film_id) FROM film WHERE rating = 'NC-17' AND release_year = 2006

question: What is the full name of the customer who rented movies for 7 consecutive days?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM customer AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS num_days FROM (SELECT *, DATE(days, '-' || rn || ' day') AS results FROM (SELECT customer_id, days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY days NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, DATE(rental_date) AS days FROM rental))) GROUP BY customer_id, results HAVING num_days = 7) AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id

question: How many payments were made throughout the month of August 2005?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE payment_date LIKE '2005-08%'

question: Please list the IDs of all the cars on train no.1 that have 2 wheels.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cars WHERE train_id = 1 AND wheels = 2

question: What is the total number of short cars on all the trains that run in the east direction?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.len = 'short' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count FROM cars AS T1 INNER JOIN trains AS T2 ON T1.train_id = T2.id WHERE T2.direction = 'east'

question: How many cars on a train that runs in the east direction have a flat roof?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.roof = 'flat' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count FROM cars AS T1 INNER JOIN trains AS T2 ON T1.train_id = T2.id WHERE T2.direction = 'east'

question: How many short cars are in the shape of hexagon?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM cars WHERE shape = 'hexagon' AND len = 'short'

question: How many trains are running west?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM trains WHERE direction = 'west'

question: How many female users reshared their tweets?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.UserID) FROM twitter AS T1 INNER JOIN user AS T2 ON T1.UserID = T2.UserID WHERE T2.Gender = 'Female' AND T1.IsReshare = 'TRUE'

question: Which courses were taught by a professor who is not a faculty member?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.course_id FROM person AS T1 INNER JOIN taughtBy AS T2 ON T1.p_id = T2.p_id WHERE T1.professor = 1 AND T1.hasPosition = 0

question: By how much did Elly Koss's weight increase from the observation in 2008 to the observation in 2009?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2009' THEN T2.VALUE END) - SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2008' THEN T2.VALUE END) AS increase, T2.units FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN observations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Elly' AND T1.last = 'Koss' AND T2.description = 'Body Height'

question: Among the patients that died, what is the condition of the oldest patient?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE NOT T2.deathdate IS NULL ORDER BY TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.deathdate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.birthdate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: List down the address of patients who have billable period in 2010.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.address FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN claims AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.BILLABLEPERIOD LIKE '2010%'

question: Calculate the average age of patients with prediabetes care plan.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.deathdate IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.STOP AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.birthdate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') ELSE TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.deathdate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.birthdate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.patient), 0) FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Prediabetes'

question: Which two products has the highest and lowest expected profits? Determine the total price for each product in terms of the largest quantity that was ordered.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.productName, SUM(T1.quantityOrdered * T1.priceEach) FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT productCode, productName FROM products ORDER BY MSRP - buyPrice DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode UNION SELECT T2.productName, SUM(quantityOrdered * priceEach) FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT productCode, productName FROM products ORDER BY MSRP - buyPrice ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode

question: Please list the IDs of all the matches in the year 2008.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT Match_Id FROM "Match" WHERE SUBSTRING(Match_Date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2008'

question: Who is the youngest player to have won the Purple Cap?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.Player_Name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Season AS T2 ON T1.Player_Id = T2.Purple_Cap ORDER BY T2.Season_Year - SUBSTRING(T1.DOB FROM 1 FOR 4) NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

question: How many players were born in the 80s and have bowling skill of 2?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(Player_Name) FROM Player WHERE DOB LIKE '198%' AND Bowling_skill = 2

question: How many matches are there in April, 2008?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(Match_Id) FROM Match WHERE Match_date LIKE '2008-04%'

question: Please list the countries under the lending category of the International Development Associations and have a external debt reporting finished by estimation.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT ShortName, ExternalDebtReportingStatus FROM Country WHERE LendingCategory = 'IDA'

question: How many footnotes did Aruba got on different series code in the year 2002?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.SeriesCode) FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN FootNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T1.ShortName = 'Aruba' AND T2.Year = 'YR2002'

question: List out the series code and country code of the poor countries that located in Latin American & Carribbean.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.SeriesCode, T2.CountryCode FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN CountryNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T1.Region = 'Latin America & Caribbean' AND t1.incomegroup = 'Low income'

question: Mention the series code of countries using Australian dollar as their currency unit. Which country belongs to middle income group among them.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.CountryCode, T2.SeriesCode FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN CountryNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T1.CurrencyUnit = 'Australian dollar' AND T1.IncomeGroup = 'Lower middle income'

question: List out the country code and country name of the rich countries using Euro as their currency unit
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.CountryCode, T2.CountryName FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN Indicators AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.CurrencyUnit = 'Euro' AND (T1.IncomeGroup = 'High income: OECD' OR T1.IncomeGroup = 'High income: nonOECD')

question: List out the table name and currency unit of countries using series code as FP.CPI.TOTL
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.TableName, T1.CurrencyUnit FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN CountryNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T2.SeriesCode = 'FP.CPI.TOTL'

question: State the table name of country with description of "Covers mainland Tanzania only".
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.TableName FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN CountryNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T2.Description = 'Covers mainland Tanzania only.'

question: Write down the description and series code of Benin in year 2005.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.Description, T2.Seriescode FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN FootNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T1.TableName = 'Benin' AND T2.Year = 'YR2005'

question: How many countries are using the same type of currency? Please list the short names of any 3 countries.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT ShortName FROM country WHERE currencyunit = 'U.S. dollar' LIMIT 3

question: What South Asian nations have low incomes? Please include the entire names of the nations in your answer.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT LongName FROM Country WHERE IncomeGroup = 'Low income' AND Region = 'South Asia'

question: Please provide full name of any two countries using special trade system.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT LongName FROM Country WHERE SystemOfTrade = 'Special trade system' LIMIT 2

question: Please calculate negative critical reception of American movies
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.movieid), 0) FROM u2base AS T1 INNER JOIN movies AS T2 ON T1.movieid = T2.movieid WHERE T2.country = 'USA'

question: Among the English comedy movies produced in the UK, how many movies with a running time of 3 was rated the highest by users between the age 45-50? Indicate the movie names.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.movieid FROM movies AS T1 INNER JOIN movies2directors AS T2 ON T1.movieid = T2.movieid INNER JOIN u2base AS T3 ON T1.movieid = T3.movieid INNER JOIN users AS T4 ON T3.userid = T4.userid WHERE T1.country = 'UK' AND T2.genre = 'Comedy' AND T1.runningtime = 3 AND T3.rating = 5 AND T4.age BETWEEN 45 AND 50 AND T1.isEnglish = 'T'

question: Among the role playing game genre, how many are targeted to teens and what is their average sentiment polarity score?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.App), AVG(T2.Sentiment_Polarity) FROM playstore AS T1 INNER JOIN user_reviews AS T2 ON T1.App = T2.App WHERE T1."Content Rating" = 'Teen' AND T1.Genres = 'Role Playing'

question: List out the product name of order which has unit cost of 781.22.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1."Unit Cost" = 781.22 THEN T2."Product Name" ELSE NULL END AS T FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN Products AS T2 ON T2.ProductID = T1._ProductID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: Please list the names of customers who have total orders of over 3 in 2018.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN COUNT(T2.CustomerID) > 3 THEN T2."Customer Names" ELSE NULL END FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN Customers AS T2 ON T2.CustomerID = T1._CustomerID WHERE T1.OrderDate LIKE '%/%/18' GROUP BY T1._CustomerID HAVING COUNT(T2.CustomerID)

question: Describe the product names delivered in 2021 for the customer "Sundial".
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.DeliveryDate LIKE '%/%/21' AND T1."Customer Names" = 'Sundial ' THEN T3."Product Name" END AS T FROM Customers AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Orders" AS T2 ON T2._CustomerID = T1.CustomerID INNER JOIN Products AS T3 ON T3.ProductID = T2._ProductID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: List the order numbers and product names which were ordered on 6th June, 2018.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT OrderNumber, "Product Name" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN T2.OrderDate = '6/6/18' THEN T2.OrderNumber ELSE NULL END AS "OrderNumber", CASE WHEN T2.OrderDate = '6/6/18' THEN T1."Product Name" ELSE NULL END AS "Product Name" FROM Products AS T1 INNER JOIN "Sales Orders" AS T2 ON T2._ProductID = T1.ProductID) WHERE NOT OrderNumber IS NULL AND NOT "Product Name" IS NULL

question: Please indicate store id in the state of California that have been applied 20% discount in store.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.State = 'California' AND T1."Sales Channel" = 'In-Store' AND T1."Discount Applied" = 0.2 THEN T2.StoreID END AS T FROM "Sales Orders" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Store Locations" AS T2 ON T2.StoreID = T1._StoreID) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: What is the type of store located in the city with the highest amount of water area?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX("Water Area") THEN Type END FROM "Store Locations"

question: What is the highest final-time score across all divisions in the 2021 season? Which team was the team that made up that score?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT GREATEST(MAX(FTAG), MAX(FTHG)) FROM matchs WHERE season = 2021) AS T1, AwayTeam FROM matchs WHERE season = 2021 AND FTHG = T1 OR FTAG = T1

question: How old was Alexis Ajinca when he was first drafted?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT draftYear - TO_CHAR(CAST(birthDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') FROM draft AS T1 INNER JOIN players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.firstName = 'Alexis' AND T1.lastName = 'Ajinca' AND draftRound = 1

question: Tell the number of games whose publisher id is 352.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.game_id FROM game_publisher AS T WHERE T.publisher_id = 352

question: List down the record ID of records released between 2000 to 2003.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T.id FROM game_platform AS T WHERE T.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003

question: What is the total number of sales across all regions?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T.num_sales) * 100000 FROM region_sales AS t

question: What is the least common game genre?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T.game_name FROM (SELECT T2.game_name, COUNT(T2.id) FROM genre AS T1 INNER JOIN game AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.genre_id GROUP BY T2.game_name ORDER BY COUNT(T2.id) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS t

question: What is the name of the publisher that released the most video games in 2007?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T3.publisher_name FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T2 ON T1.game_publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T2.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T1.release_year = 2007 GROUP BY T3.publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.game_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the genre of the game '2 Games in 1: Sonic Advance & ChuChu Rocket!'?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.genre_name FROM game AS T1 INNER JOIN genre AS T2 ON T1.genre_id = T2.id WHERE T1.game_name = '2 Games in 1: Sonic Advance & ChuChu Rocket!'

question: How many games include the word 'Box' in their name?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T.game_name FROM game AS T WHERE T.game_name LIKE '%Box%')

question: How many games were published by Activision?

pg_gold_sql: SELECT T FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN state = 'Delaware' THEN state_abbr ELSE NULL END AS T FROM state_sector_grads) WHERE NOT T IS NULL

question: How many female users were surveyed in the mental health survey for 2017 in the state of Nebraska?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T2.UserID FROM Question AS T1 INNER JOIN Answer AS T2 ON T1.questionid = T2.QuestionID INNER JOIN Survey AS T3 ON T2.SurveyID = T3.SurveyID WHERE T3.Description = 'mental health survey for 2017' AND T1.questionid = 2 AND T2.AnswerText = 'Female' UNION SELECT T2.UserID FROM Question AS T1 INNER JOIN Answer AS T2 ON T1.questionid = T2.QuestionID INNER JOIN Survey AS T3 ON T2.SurveyID = T3.SurveyID WHERE T1.questionid = 4 AND T2.AnswerText = 'Nebraska' AND T3.Description = 'mental health survey for 2017')

question: List the full name of all current female senators.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name FROM "current-terms" AS T1 INNER JOIN current AS T2 ON T2.bioguide_id = T1.bioguide WHERE T1.type = 'sen' AND T2.gender_bio = 'F' GROUP BY T2.ballotpedia_id

question: How many sweet bottled root beers that do not contain cane sugar were purchased in 2015 through the selling company located in Sac State American River Courtyard?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.BrandID) FROM rootbeer AS T1 INNER JOIN rootbeerbrand AS T2 ON T1.BrandID = T2.BrandID INNER JOIN location AS T3 ON T1.LocationID = T3.LocationID WHERE T3.LocationName = 'Sac State American River Courtyard' AND T1.PurchaseDate LIKE '2015%' AND T2.Honey = 'TRUE' AND T2.CaneSugar = 'FALSE' AND T1.ContainerType = 'Bottle'

question: Name the coin that has the highest market capitalization for all transactions in 2018.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM coins AS T1 INNER JOIN historical AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.coin_id WHERE T2.date LIKE '2018%' AND T2.market_cap = (SELECT MAX(market_cap) FROM historical WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2018')

question: List all the inactive coins and state the last date of its transaction?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.NAME, MAX(T2.DATE) FROM coins AS T1 INNER JOIN historical AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.coin_id WHERE T1.status = 'inactive' ORDER BY T2.DATE DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: How many coins were added in May 2013? Please list the names of coins.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS num FROM coins WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(date_added AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY-MM') = '2013-05' UNION ALL SELECT name FROM coins WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(date_added AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY-MM') = '2013-05'

question: Customer No.129301 made an order on 1996/7/27, what was the delivery time for the first part of that order?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT JULIANDAY(T2.l_receiptdate) - JULIANDAY(T2.l_commitdate) FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN lineitem AS T2 ON T1.o_orderkey = T2.l_orderkey WHERE T1.o_custkey = '129301' AND T1.o_orderdate = '1996-07-27'

question: How many urgent orders were shipped the next day?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.o_orderkey) FROM lineitem AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T2.o_orderkey = T1.l_orderkey WHERE JULIANDAY(T1.l_shipdate) - JULIANDAY(T2.o_orderdate) = 1 AND T2.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'

question: Which ship mode has more "deliver in person" instructions, rail or mail?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l_shipmode = 'RAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN l_shipmode = 'MAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'RAIL' ELSE 'MAIL' END AS result FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'

question: What are the top 2 countries with the highest number of indebted suppliers?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T.n_name FROM (SELECT T2.n_name, SUM(T1.s_acctbal) AS num FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN nation AS T2 ON T1.s_nationkey = T2.n_nationkey WHERE T1.s_acctbal < 0 GROUP BY T1.s_nationkey) AS T ORDER BY T.num NULLS FIRST LIMIT 2

question: How many transactions are there for product under the Mountain line?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.TransactionID) FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN TransactionHistory AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.ProductLine = 'M'

question: What is the job title of the newest employee in department 12?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.JobTitle FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T2.DepartmentID = 12 ORDER BY T2.StartDate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: How many vendors only consented to move on with the 500 to 15000 piece order in terms of quality?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ProductVendor WHERE MinOrderQty > 500 AND MaxOrderQty < 15000

question: What percentage of the AdventureWorks data is in Thai?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Name = 'Thai' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.CultureID), 0) FROM Culture AS T1 INNER JOIN ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture AS T2 ON T1.CultureID = T2.CultureID

question: What is the average age of the sales agents in the company by 12/31/2009?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(2009 - TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.BirthDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY')) FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T1.PersonType = 'SP'

question: What is the current status of the order with the highest shipping cost?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT Status FROM SalesOrderHeader ORDER BY Freight DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Name the oldest employee who is working on night shift. How old is the employee?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, TO_CHAR(CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(BirthDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T3 ON T2.BusinessEntityID = T3.BusinessEntityID WHERE T3.ShiftId = 3 ORDER BY TO_CHAR(CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(BirthDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the average age of employee in Adventure Works?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(TO_CHAR(CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(CAST(BirthDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY')) FROM Employee

question: Which product has the highest price in 2012?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT ProductID FROM ProductListPriceHistory WHERE StartDate LIKE '2012%' ORDER BY ListPrice DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the shortest life expectancy?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

question: Provide the name, located country, and life expectancy of the most populated city
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name, T1.Code, T1.LifeExpectancy FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN City AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode ORDER BY T2.Population DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the smallest surface area?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Country ORDER BY SurfaceArea ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the smallest surface area and the most crowded city?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM City AS T1 INNER JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code ORDER BY T1.Population DESC NULLS LAST, T2.SurfaceArea DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Calculate the average score of university ID 79 between year 2013 to 2015.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(score) FROM university_ranking_year WHERE year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015 AND university_id = 79

question: Describe the specific description and case locations under IUCR 142.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.secondary_description, T2.latitude, T2.longitude FROM IUCR AS T1 INNER JOIN Crime AS T2 ON T1.iucr_no = T2.iucr_no WHERE T2.iucr_no = 142

question: Please list the area name of the communities in the Far north side, which has a population of more than 50000 but less than 70000.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT community_area_name, side FROM Community_Area WHERE side = 'Far North ' AND population BETWEEN 50000 AND 70000

question: Name the station and city with the most borrowed bike.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.start_station_name, T1.city FROM station AS T1 INNER JOIN trip AS T2 ON T2.start_station_name = T1.name GROUP BY T2.start_station_name ORDER BY COUNT(T2.start_station_name) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: On 10/20/2014, what is the duration of the fastest trip which started from the station with latitude and longitudes of 37.789625 and -122.400811, respectively? Indicate the bike id.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT MIN(T2.duration), T2.bike_id FROM station AS T1 INNER JOIN trip AS T2 ON T2.start_station_name = T1.name WHERE T2.start_date LIKE '10/20/2014%' AND T1.lat = 37.789625 AND T1.long = -122.400811

question: What is the maximum humidity in Powell Street BART when bike 496 was borrowed from the station on 8/29/2013?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T2.max_humidity FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code WHERE T1.start_date LIKE '8/29/2013%' AND T1.bike_id = 496 AND T1.start_station_name = 'Powell Street BART'

question: List down the trip IDs when bike no. 10 was used by subscribers and the weather's mean temperature is no less than 62 degress Fahrenheit.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.id FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code WHERE T1.bike_id = 10 AND T2.mean_temperature_f > 62 AND T1.subscription_type = 'Subscriber'

question: For the rides that started at Market at 10th station and ended at South Van Ness at Market station in August of 2013, which day had the coldest temperature?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.start_date FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code AND T2.date = SUBSTRING(CAST(T1.start_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(' ' IN T1.start_date) - 1) WHERE T2.date LIKE '8/%/2013' AND T1.start_station_name = 'Market at 10th' AND T1.end_station_name = 'South Van Ness at Market' AND T2.min_temperature_f = (SELECT MIN(T2.min_temperature_f) FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code AND T2.date = SUBSTRING(CAST(T1.start_date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(' ' IN T1.start_date) - 1) WHERE T2.date LIKE '8/%/2013' AND T1.start_station_name = 'Market at 10th' AND T1.end_station_name = 'South Van Ness at Market')

question: Find the average ride duration during the rain of more than 0.8 inches.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.duration) FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code WHERE (T2.events = 'Rain' AND T2.precipitation_inches > 0.8) OR (T2.events = 'rain' AND T2.precipitation_inches > 0.8)

question: Which year had the most number of trips that started at stations in San Francisco?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(CAST(T1.start_date AS TEXT) FROM POSITION(' ' IN T1.start_date) FOR -4) FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN station AS T2 ON T2.name = T1.start_station_name WHERE T2.city = 'San Francisco' GROUP BY T1.start_station_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Please list trips id started on the hottest day.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.id FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code ORDER BY T2.max_temperature_f DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What was duration of the longest trip started on the day that has a maximum wind speed of 30 mph?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT T1.duration FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code WHERE T2.max_wind_Speed_mph = 30 ORDER BY T1.duration DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Please calculate the average temperature of those trips that started at Market at 4th in 2013.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.mean_temperature_f) FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(T2.date AS TEXT) FROM LENGTH(CAST(T2.date AS TEXT)) - 3) = '2013' AND T1.start_station_name = 'Market at 4th'

question: How many rainy days were recorded in Mountain View?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN zip_code = 94041 AND events = 'Rain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM weather

question: Convert all temperature recorded at San Francisco city during August 2013 into degree Celsius.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT (max_temperature_f - 32) / NULLIF(1.8000, 0), (mean_temperature_f - 32) / NULLIF(1.8000, 0), (min_temperature_f - 32) / NULLIF(1.8000, 0) FROM weather WHERE SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN date) - 1) = '8' AND SUBSTRING(CAST(date AS TEXT) FROM LENGTH(CAST(date AS TEXT)) - 3) = '2013' AND zip_code = 94107

question: What is the average duration of trips for the starting station of Santa Clara at Almaden and what is the latitude and longitude of this station?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.duration), T2.lat, T2.long FROM trip AS T1 LEFT JOIN station AS T2 ON T2.name = T1.start_station_name LEFT JOIN station AS T3 ON T3.name = T1.end_station_name WHERE T1.start_station_name = 'Santa Clara at Almaden'

question: How many subscribers have ended their trip at MLK Library and how many docks does that station have?
pg_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id), T2.dock_count FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN station AS T2 ON T2.name = T1.start_station_name WHERE T1.end_station_name = 'MLK Library' AND T1.subscription_type = 'Subscriber' AND T2.dock_count = 19

question: Calculate the average duration travelled by subscribers that both started and ended their trip in Mountain View City Hall and indicate the date when the station was first installed.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.duration), T2.installation_date FROM trip AS T1 INNER JOIN station AS T2 ON T2.name = T1.start_station_name WHERE T1.start_station_name = 'Mountain View City Hall' AND T1.subscription_type = 'Subscriber' AND T1.end_station_name = 'Mountain View City Hall'

question: Please list the titles of the films that are released in 2006 and have a rental rate of $2.99.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE release_year = 2006 AND rental_rate = 2.99

question: Calculate customers' total payment amount in August, 2005.
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE SUBSTRING(payment_date FROM 1 FOR 7) = '2005-08'
